Keeping 65 aliases alive therefore means 65 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the hollow quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 409 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
